sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 30 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、SNDK、NBIS、MSTR、META。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Semiconductor sector erupts broadly, propping up the indices: Intraday (11:03 ET), QQQ +1.07%, SPY +0.45%, but Dow ETF DIA only +0.08% and IWM +0.17%, showing an extreme divergence of "green indices, more than half of stocks red." The leaders were all chip/compute-chain names — SOXL +10%, AMAT +6%, ASML +4.9%, MRVL +6.8%, NBIS +9.5%, AMD +4.1%, INTC +4.6%, SNDK +6.5%, while NVDA +1.3% relatively lagged. The community joked that "S&P = Semi & Poors."
  • SK Hynix files for U.S. IPO, stirring up the memory sector: SK Hynix filed an F-1/A with the SEC, planning to list on Nasdaq under SKHY, targeting fundraising of about $29.4 billion (larger than Alibaba in 2014 and Saudi Aramco), with trading expected to begin on July 10. This gave rise to the day's core narrative in the community: capital is being pulled out of MU to reserve "dry powder" for the SKHY IPO, explaining the stunning divergence between MU (+0.07%, moving sideways all day within a ±0.5% range) and SNDK (+6.5%).
  • MSTR continues to collapse, crypto chain keeps bleeding: MSTR -9.4% led declines among major large caps and was mocked as a "death spiral/Ponzi"; COIN -5.7%, IBIT -3.4%, with BTC hitting a recent low near 58k. Community consensus was that "crypto is dead," and Saylor became the target of universal criticism.
  • JOLTS beats expectations → rate-hike expectations heat up: May job openings were stronger than expected, further feeding bets on rate hikes this year (rather than cuts). Yet the market "did not fall on good employment, but rose instead," while the 3-month Treasury bill auction saw a relatively high primary-dealer share (weaker demand).
  • SCOTUS issues several major rulings: In a 5-4 decision, it ruled to protect Federal Reserve governors from being dismissed by the White House without cause (strengthening Fed independence); it also ruled on cases involving birthright citizenship, campaign-contribution limits, transgender campus sports, and more.
  • AVAV earnings afterglow + defense drone theme: AVAV +14% (yesterday's earnings, with revenue +133%, triggered a surge), lifting drone/defense stocks such as KTOS +4%; on the energy/data-center side, FCEL +20%, VRT +6.3%.
  • Single-stock catalysts: NKE reports earnings after the close tonight (intraday -1.2%); META -1.7%, NFLX -2.2%, ORCL -1.8%, AMZN -0.8%, with software/SaaS and parts of Mag7 continuing to weaken; AAPL +2% attracted defensive buying.

社区氛围：极度贪婪和嘲笑熊占主导地位，“我们他妈的回来了”、“BERS DED”和“庆祝独立日 ATH”充斥着董事会。但其背后却是对“算法操纵、先是假冒然后是 V 形复苏以及午前抛售压力”的疲倦和不信任，以及 MU/META/MSFT/软件股票持有者的巨大哀叹，“除了我的，一切都是绿色的”。

恐惧/贪婪：贪婪（约75/100）。 VIX极低，社区抱怨“波动性被抽干，没有崩盘”。但贪婪集中在芯片/计算领域，而软件、加密货币和一些 Mag7 名称则处于废弃的恐慌区；不同行业的情绪差异很大。

情绪与现实：社区的“全面看涨”叙述与实际情况背道而驰——唯一真正强劲的领域是半导体，市场广度较弱，道指几乎持平，META/AMZN/ORCL/NFLX 下跌。嘲讽熊市的兴奋更多是因为 QQQ 的头条新闻，而不是广泛的反弹。
